description: SAMPLE. The data model as code: publisher, solutions, languages and every table, column and choice the product owns. build/New-Schema.ps1 applies it to a DEVELOPMENT environment (additive only: it creates what is missing and never deletes or retypes), Export-Solution.ps1 brings the result into solutions/, and tests/contracts/schema.test.mjs holds this file, the unpacked solutions, roles.json and privacy.json to each other. Rules: every name starts with the publisher prefix; schema names never change once released; option values start at optionValuePrefix * 10000 and are never reused; every label has every LCID in languages.lcids. Replace the sample (contoso, CaseApp, contoso_Request) with the product's own.

languages.$comment: The base language is the one the development environment was created with and cannot change. Every other LCID needs its language enabled in each environment (Power Platform admin center, Settings, Languages) before labels in it import. Map from build/contracts/locales.json: en-US 1033, en-GB 2057, nl-NL 1043, de-DE 1031, fr-FR 1036, es-ES 3082, it-IT 1040, pl-PL 1045, pt-PT 2070, sv-SE 1053, da-DK 1030, fi-FI 1035, nb-NO 1044.

solutions.description: Tables, choices, environment variables and connection references. No apps, no flows: those live in the solutions that depend on this one.
